articlesShipped.topicGap: Rosemary (Salvia rosmarinus) had no existing pruning article despite being one of the most common low-hedge and edging species in CT10 coastal chalk gardens. The species shares the old-wood-regeneration constraint with lavender (which has its own article) but has different cultivar characteristics, frost-hardiness profile, timing window and replacement cycle on Margate Chalk. The secateurs-over-trimmer constraint and the post-flowering-only window are the load-bearing procedural differentiators from the general hedge-cutting-technique article.

articlesShipped.topicGap: Spiraea japonica and spring-flowering spiraea types had no existing article.
